steps: Cut the cod into 3–4 equal pieces; rinse and pat dry. In a small saucepan, bring 1/4 cup water and the sugar to a boil. Stir in the miso and mirin (or sake) and heat over medium-high until the sugar dissolves. Cool completely, then coat the cod in the marinade in a dish and marinate at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.

Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) and line a sheet pan with foil. Wipe excess marinade from the fish (do not rinse) and place skin-side down. Toss the asparagus and sliced shiitake with the vegetable oil and sesame oil, season with salt and pepper, and scatter around the fish.
Bake about 10 minutes, until the fish flakes but stays moist and the vegetables are tender. Switch to broil for 2–3 minutes until golden and caramelized — watch closely to avoid burning. Serve.
notes: Make-ahead: the cod needs to marinate at least 4 hours (ideally overnight) before cooking. Active hands-on time is ~30 min.
